description: This file implements the TestRootCerts class and related classes for managing test root certificates, including adding, clearing, and checking known roots, as well as scoped management of test roots.

classes.name: TestRootCerts
classes.description: Manages test root certificates, including adding, clearing, and checking roots.

classes.name: ScopedTestRoot
classes.description: Scoped management of test root certificates, automatically adding and removing certs.

classes.name: ScopedTestKnownRoot
classes.description: Scoped management of a known root certificate.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TestRootCerts.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::Add
methods.description: Adds a certificate with specified trust to the test trust store.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::AddKnownRoot
methods.description: Adds a DER-encoded root certificate to the known roots set.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::Clear
methods.description: Clears all stored trust and known root certificates.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the trust store is empty.

methods.name: TestRootCerts::IsKnownRoot
methods.description: Checks if a DER-encoded certificate is a known root.

methods.name: ScopedTestRoot::Reset
methods.description: Resets the scoped test root with given certificates and trust.
